title: orhun/ratty
claim: orhun/ratty — A GPU-rendered terminal emulator with inline 3D graphics 🐀🧀
why_good: A GPU-rendered terminal with inline 3D graphics from a prolific Rust-TUI author — pushes what a terminal can display.
value: Terminals monetize poorly (free by culture); at best a pro tier, or it's a beloved OSS showcase.
risk: Terminal emulators are a free, crowded space (Ghostty, WezTerm); inline 3D is cool but niche.

zh.claim: orhun/ratty —— GPU 渲染、支持内联 3D 图形的终端模拟器。
zh.why_good: 来自高产 Rust-TUI 作者的 GPU 渲染终端,支持内联 3D 图形——拓展了终端能显示的边界。
zh.value: 终端很难变现(文化上免费);顶多做专业档,否则是个受喜爱的开源展示。
zh.risk: 终端模拟器是免费、拥挤的空间(Ghostty、WezTerm);内联 3D 很酷但小众。
